silhouette.reason: Big vault, long nose, receding chin and swung pointed ears read as a goblin from front and side; the cleanest silhouette of the five.
fixes: hook the nose tip more and notch the ear rims

proportions.reason: Head, vault and nose projection hold; the eyes are human-sized, where goblins read better with larger eyes.
fixes: eyeball ×1.3 with a matching socket landmark scale

materials.reason: Vertex colour on the plain strip: green skin zones separate by hue but not by roughness or subsurface; it reads as matte painted clay. No hair.
fixes: a skin strip with subsurface-like roughness/sheen

detail.reason: Primary and secondary forms come from a real anatomical base (lids, nasolabial area, lips, ear helix, clavicles, sternocleidomastoid), but there is no tertiary layer (pores, wrinkles) and the hair is evenly spaced grooves.
fixes: LOD0 wrinkle/pore displacement on the subdivided base driven by age
varied lock widths and a parting instead of evenly spaced grooves

wear.reason: Pristine: seeded asymmetry and age/weight knobs are the only story; no scars, stubble, blemishes, sun-darkened skin or dirt.
fixes: seeded scar/blemish marks in vertex colour
stubble shadow on the jaw and age-driven darkening under the eyes

lod.reason: LOD2 loses most of each ear (thin sheets under the 1.4 cm cell) and the face goes blotchy: the silhouette changes at distance.
fixes: authored LOD2 topology, or keep the ear shells from LOD1

technical.reason: QA PASS at every LOD; 48.9k / 13k / 5.7k tris (no hair); 2 draws.
fixes: drop the teeth at LOD1 (barely visible)
